name: Gonzalo Thought
summary: Gonzalo Thought is the Peruvian Communist Party (Shining Path) application of Marxism-Leninism-Maoism to Peru, set out by Abimael Guzman as 'Presidente Gonzalo'. It makes the conquest and defence of power through universal people's war its centre, with a militarised Party commanding the army, a democratic stage under a worker-peasant front, then socialism and successive cultural revolutions. It rejects elections, revisionism and imperialism, and it names Guzman as head of the Party and the revolution.
scope: The party's own line as written in its 1988 Foundational Documents and in the 1988 El Diario interview with Gonzalo, plus scholarship on how it worked. It covers the Peruvian Communist Party (Shining Path) under Guzman until his 1992 capture. It leaves out Maoism in general, later splinters, and the party's actions, since the party was never the governing party of a state.
